description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Returns up to limit rows of reported first-tier subcontract award information from GovInbox's stored USAspending subaward data. Returns reported relationships only, without inferring unreported relationships. Amounts are prime-reported subcontract award amounts, not cash paid or obligations. Reporting may be incomplete or duplicated, and a missing result does not prove that a subcontract relationship does not exist. This tool does not support pagination. Does not suggest partners, recommend bids, or determine eligibility. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use, regardless of the number of records returned. Without a connected GovInbox account, both limits apply: 3 searches per UTC calendar day and 10 per UTC calendar month. With a connected free GovInbox account, the limit is 20 searches per UTC calendar month, with no separate daily limit. One accepted search counts as one use, regardless of the number of records returned. Follow-up calls (opening records, comparing versions, listing awards or subawards) within 30 minutes after a search do not count extra, up to 30 follow-ups per search. A follow-up invoked with no active search window counts as one use and opens a new 30-minute window. Empty results consume the search. A lookup for a record that does not exist is not charged. Each retry of a search counts as a new search, as does each call for another page of search results. Daily limits reset at 00:00 UTC each day; monthly limits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month. Requests rejected for invalid authentication or an exhausted quota do not consume a use.
